cc:Work.dc:title: Compact 2D U-Net architecture
cc:Work.dc:description: Original schematic: four MRI input channels, encoder channels 16, 32, 64, bottleneck 128, mirrored decoder and four output logits.

g.text: 482,228 parameters · Three encoder / decoder levels · Original project schematic

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172b46

g.text: Each block: two padded 3 × 3 convolutions + ReLU. Up: 2 × 2 transposed convolution, stride 2.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172b46

g.text: Inputs: FLAIR, T1w, T1Gd, T2w. Outputs: background, edema, non-enhancing and enhancing tumour.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53657e

g.text: Feature sizes are shown after each block. No batch normalization or dropout. U-Net concept: Ronneberger et al. (2015).
